Name: Iridium Serpents
Author: BeneathThePlass
Description:
I use the fantastic [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3308]Dark Skull Cavern[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/29644045]coldazrael[/url], and have for awhile, which is what inspired this mod. I wished the serpents were a little bit less invisible, a little brighter, since the black and red design of the mod can disappear against the dark background of the caves- until they're right on top of you that is! XD I decided to recolor the serpent for myself, so it wouldn't be quite as bright as the vanilla green and yellow, but would be brighter than the black and red design included in Dark Skull Cavern. So I bring to you- an iridium recolor of the ﻿serpent!


[b]Installation: [/b]
[b]1.[/b] Make sure that you have both [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] correctly installed in your Stardew Valley folder.
[b]2.[/b] Unzip the '[CP] Iridium Serpents' folder and drop it into your 'Mods' folder in the main SDV game folder.
[b]3.[/b] Congrats, you're done and ready to go! Enjoy your new serpents!
